profiles.name: SpeechKit Local Voice Pipeline
profiles.description: Voice Agent pipeline fallback using local transcription, SpeechKit-managed llama.cpp dialogue, and a TTS path.

variants.name: Gemma 4 E2B IT Q8_0
variants.description: Default lightweight GGUF model for local Voice Agent pipeline fallback.

variants.name: Gemma 4 E4B IT Q4_K_M
variants.description: Stronger optional GGUF model for Voice Agent pipeline fallback.

variants.name: LFM3-1.7B Q4_K_M
variants.description: Liquid AI's compact LFM3-1.7B (LFM Open License v1.0), about 1.1 GB, for a fast local Voice Agent pipeline fallback.

profiles.name: Gemma 4 E4B Voice Pipeline (Ollama)
profiles.description: Voice Agent pipeline fallback with Ollama as the dialogue model.

profiles.name: Qwen 3.8 27B Voice Fallback (Hugging Face)
profiles.description: Voice Agent fallback over Hugging Face. SpeechKit uses the capture pipeline when Gemini Live is unavailable or not selected.

profiles.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash Voice Pipeline (OpenRouter)
profiles.description: Voice Agent pipeline fallback with OpenRouter as the dialogue model.

profiles.name: Gemini Live Native Audio
profiles.description: Opt-in native real-time voice conversation over the Google Live API with your own GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY. Gemini 3.8 Live (GA) is the primary model and reasons on its own, so a reasoning effort is not sent to it; the Extended Thinking preview adds background reasoning and runs tools non-blocking. Never a default.

variants.name: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
variants.description: Background reasoning with conversational fillers; tools always run non-blocking.

profiles.name: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
profiles.description: Opt-in Live API speech-to-speech translation profile with your own GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY. It is deliberately separate from the general Gemini Live dialogue profile so Gemini Live selections do not point at a translation-only model.

profiles.name: Deepgram Voice Agent (Flux)
profiles.description: Deepgram Voice Agent API — native audio-to-audio dialogue (Flux listen with turn events, configurable think LLM, Aura-2 speak) over a single WebSocket. Flux TTS is selectable for English-pinned sessions. Nova-3 remains the general dictation/diarization baseline.

profiles.name: AssemblyAI Voice Agent
profiles.description: AssemblyAI Voice Agent API over wss://agents.assemblyai.com/v1/ws with native session.update, session.ready, input.audio, reply.audio, transcripts, tools, and clean session.end teardown.

profiles.name: OpenAI Realtime
profiles.description: OpenAI Realtime native audio session for apps that want the same LiveProvider contract with OpenAI's realtime model. The profile id keeps its historical name; the model is gpt-realtime-2.1.

profiles.name: OpenAI GPT-Live
profiles.description: OpenAI's full-duplex GPT-Live voice (12 new voices) that delegates reasoning and tools to a backend model — SpeechKit sends the configured OpenAI agent model. Early adapter: the protocol reports no barge-in or turn-end event yet, so the kernel settles turns on its timer.

profiles.name: xAI Grok Voice
profiles.description: Opt-in native speech-to-speech session on xAI's Grok Voice Agent API (grok-voice-3.0) with your own XAI_API_KEY. Realtime-compatible events, function tools, server VAD and Grok voices. Never a default.

profiles.name: Microsoft Foundry Realtime
profiles.description: Azure-hosted OpenAI Realtime session over the Microsoft Foundry v1 websocket surface. The model id is the default deployment name — override it with your own deployment name in the Foundry integration settings. Existing gpt-realtime-2 deployments keep working: Azure upgrades them to gpt-realtime-2.1.

profiles.name: Microsoft Foundry Voice Live
profiles.description: Microsoft-native realtime voice agent: Voice Live pairs a hosted brain model with MAI-Voice-2 speech output and MAI-Transcribe-2 input transcription, plus server-side semantic turn detection and noise suppression. The MAI voice and transcription models are public preview.

variants.name: GPT Realtime 2.1 mini brain
variants.description: Lower cost realtime brain (Voice Live Standard).

variants.name: GPT-5.6 Terra brain
variants.description: Newest text brain the Voice Live service hosts itself; speech in and out come from the service.

variants.name: GPT-5.6 Luna brain
variants.description: Fast, low-cost text brain (Voice Live Standard).

variants.name: Azure Realtime brain
variants.description: Microsoft's own speech-to-speech model with its dedicated native voices.

variants.name: Phi-4 multimodal realtime brain (Preview)
variants.description: Small Microsoft model for low-latency agents.

profiles.name: Microsoft Foundry GPT-Live
profiles.description: OpenAI's full-duplex GPT-Live voice served by your Microsoft Foundry resource. The model id is the default deployment name — override it with your own GPT-Live deployment name in the Foundry integration settings. Reasoning and tools run in the configured Foundry agent deployment, which GPT-Live delegates to.
